At HUMAN MECHANIC CLINIC, we are committed to providing you and your loved ones with exceptional care in a compassionate and friendly atmosphere. Human Mechanic Clinic is known to be the best Physiotherapy and Chiropractic Clinic located in Hadapsar & Koregaon Park, Pune.

For the best treatment, We used BRAWN CONCEPT Assessment and clinically proven advanced treatment approaches like CHIROPRACTIC, OSTEOPATHY, DNS, MYOBALANCE, And ADVANCED MANUAL THERAPY.

Koregaon Park Clinic Address - Flat no.210, Gera Garden Building no.1, near Blue Diamond Hotel, Koregaon Park, Pune, Maharashtra 411001
Koregaon Park Clinic Contact Number - +918956699060

Hadapsar Clinic Address - Office No, 401 Gandharv Capital, Bhosale Nagar, Hadapsar, Pune, Maharashtra 411028
Hadapsar Clinic Contact Number - +917387411009
